images.alt: Diagram shows an illustration of a star schema for airline flight facts, where the Airport dimension is related twice to the fact table as the Departure Airport dimension and the Arrival Airport dimension.
images.credit: Microsoft Learn — Modeling Dimension Tables in Warehouse, Microsoft Fabric documentation

imageNote: Genuine Microsoft-authored diagram exists for this exact concept — the Fabric dimensional-modeling-dimension-tables page has a dedicated 'Role-playing dimensions' section illustrated with a real Flight fact / Airport dimension star schema (Departure Airport and Arrival Airport both pointing at one physical Airport dimension). Downloaded and used as the lesson's single screenshot slide. The page's own prose example (order date / ship date on a sales fact table referencing one Date dimension) is used in the written guide for continuity with this course's earlier chapters, since it's the more common warehouse scenario.
